title: Curated regulatory interactions
description: Curated transcription-factor interactions whose binding-site left coordinate is within the first 250 kb. Each record preserves the regulator, target, effect and evidence confidence.
processing: Read the official RegulonDB download-data-files repository RIdata table (release 11.1, 12/12/2022, file generated 02/07/2023). Retain records with numeric TFRS bounds and left bound below 250000, only Confirmed or Strong confidence. Binding-site width is right minus left plus one. Each regulatory interaction remains a separate record; identical sites may regulate multiple targets or have both effects.
coordinateSystem: 1-based inclusive RegulonDB binding-site bounds on NC_000913.3
limits: Historical release 11.1 from the official repository; not asserted to be the current complete database.
Only Strong/Confirmed interactions in a 250 kb coordinate subset.
Evidence-supported regulation is condition-specific; edge presence is not expression magnitude.
Binding sequence includes source flanking bases and preserves original case.
